crossRefs.note: but taking his leave of them, he said, “I must by all means keep this coming feast in Jerusalem, but I will return…
that I may come to you in joy through the will of God, and together with you, find rest.
But I will come to you shortly, if the Lord is willing. And I will know, not the word of those who are puffed up, but…
For I do not wish to see you now in passing, but I hope to stay a while with you, if the Lord permits.
For you ought to say, “If the Lord wills, we will both live, and do this or that.”
